hypothesis: Test whether a direct non-thinking action response with a larger output allowance supports sustained autonomous fortress development after the earlier thinking response exhausted its output allowance. Start from the new local digest-bound seed and record elapsed game time, actual native development and sustainability, not survival claims from infrastructure fixtures. Continue over matched native checkpoints toward and beyond one full elapsed year.
notes: Fresh local campaign from the digest-bound native seed at year 30, tick 16801. Never reuse the provider-free fixture's post-WAIT state or an old failed model campaign tail.

Compared with long-v2, this declares a different seed boundary and local VM toolchain, disabled optional thinking, a 4096-token output allowance, 2500-tick maximum action advance, and a larger cumulative campaign budget. It is not a single-variable ablation or matched historical model ranking.
Use the existing 9B quantized weights and pinned local inference runtime. Verify file, API metadata and chat-template identities before generation. No hosted provider calls or provider credentials.
All gameplay decisions are model-selected under the exploratory campaign profile. No scripted build order, forced WAIT, assisted digging, inventory injection or human gameplay rescue.

Observe a 1 GiB free-space floor and retain periodic/native handoff checkpoints. No historical data deletion or rollback. An accounted output-limit pause must remain distinct from infrastructure failure or gameplay collapse.
One model and one native game at a time; literal loopback model transport. Metered provider charges are zero, while hardware, electricity and application costs remain unmeasured.

This condition permits eight serial segments of up to 32 steps, with cumulative 512-dispatch and 8-million-token ceilings across continuations. Reaching a scheduling limit is not reaching a game outcome.

Repeated matched campaigns across at least three models remain required before strong comparison claims. A functioning fortress at one full elapsed year and continued year-two play remain acceptance requirements.
